appliedUpdates.description: Updated architecture.md with complete promotion component list (CollapsibleCard, SkinnyColumnBar, BasicDetailsEditor, DiscountEntriesEditor, FormattableItemEditor, SpecialHoursEditor, PDFAttachments, SubjectLineGenerator, BulkEmailTools, PreviewColumn), ID generation convention (Date.now()*1000 + monotonic counter), IndexedDB ownership (store owns PDF save/load, db.ts owns all CRUD), and the useIndexedDB hook pattern (exists but not consistently used across components).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Expand XSS prevention convention: 'sanitizeHTML() from html-utils must be applied to ALL user-controlled data interpolated into HTML, including profile-derived fields (storeAddress, storePhone, storeEmail, storeHours) and dateRange. Profile data is also user input, even though it originates from a different page.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature promotion-preview-and-export found that promotion-email-html.ts properly escapes user-input fields (entries, how-to-shop, notes) but leaves profile-derived fields (storeAddress, storePhone, storeEmail, storeHours) and dateRange unescaped via escapeHtml(). This violates the existing convention which only mentions 'user input' ambiguously.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: ESLint config (eslint.config.js) currently only covers legacy src/js/**/*.js files. All new React TypeScript files (src/components/**/*.tsx, src/pages/**/*.tsx, src/stores/**/*.ts, src/lib/**/*.ts) are not covered. Either update eslint.config.js to include these paths, or document that linting of React files is handled by tsc --noEmit only.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature promotion-editors noted that eslint.config.js line files: ['src/js/**/*.js'] only covers legacy JS. The npx eslint src/ command exits 0 because it finds no matching files for the new React code. All 23 warnings are in legacy JS files.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update frontend-worker skill to note that agent-browser may need direct URL navigation (e.g., navigating to http://localhost:8080/promotion directly) instead of clicking navigation links when testing React SPA routes. The React Router client-side navigation may not work reliably with Playwright link-clicking in all cases.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature promotion-layout-and-cards worker used Python Playwright script with direct URL navigation instead of agent-browser because agent-browser couldn't navigate to React SPA routes correctly (was navigating to old vanilla HTML routes).
